en.details: Simplify excise duty calculations with flexible methods that better reflect your organization’s tax scenarios. Configure excise duties using specific, ad valorem, or hybrid calculation methods, including calculations based on different tax bases, thresholds, quantities, percentages, or combinations of these factors. Benefits • Support specific, ad valorem, and hybrid excise duty calculation methods. • Handle multi-factor and industry-specific excise tax scenarios with greater flexibility and accuracy. • Reduce the need for manual tax adjustments and external calculations.
